name: 王可
objective:
This course develops students’ English writing through poetry and the personal essay. Students generate material through focused writing, study how writers make choices, share drafts in workshops, and revise their own work.

Learning Objectives
1. Create a poem using deliberate choices in imagery, language and form.
2. Develop a personal essay that connects a particular experience with reflection.
3. Revise a draft to strengthen its structure, detail and language.
4. Explain a writing choice using examples from their own work.
These objectives describe the poetry, essay, in-class writing and reflection work in the current Course Map.
schedule:
POETRY
Week 1: Focused Freewrites
Week 2: Dream Writing & Six Word Stories
Week 3: Intro to Poetry
Week 4: Association, Juxtaposition, Turn
Week 5: Personification & Details
Week 6: Poetry Workshop; workshop draft due October 14
Week 7: No class meeting; asynchronous work
Week 8: Poetic Devices; final poem due Sunday, November 1
PERSONAL ESSAY
Week 9: Tension
Week 10: From Situation to Reflection
Week 11: Scene and Detail
Week 12: Reading Essays; exploratory draft due
Week 13: Cohesion and Coherence
Week 14: Revision; workshop draft due
Week 15: Voice
Week 16: Precise Language & Cliché; final essay due
Dates may change based on class needs; changes will be announced in advance.
scorePolicy:
Poem: 25%
Personal Essay: 30%
Participation and Attendance: 30%
Regular In-Class Writing: 10%
Flexible Learning: 5%

Assignment directions and criteria will be provided with each task. Follow the AI guidance for each task; students remain responsible for their own writing decisions and revisions.
